response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with strong full-stack, DLang, and Node.js/TypeScript expertise, but the resume shows no evidence of Kotlin experience, Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate ecosystem work, or deep JVM internals knowledge required for this role. While there is tangential IDE tooling experience (C IDE work at National Instruments), it is unrelated to JVM/Java tooling, making this a poor match for the specific enterprise Java/Kotlin IDE position.
strengths: Extensive, diverse senior/staff-level engineering experience across many domains
Demonstrated IDE tooling experience (NI LabWindows/CVI C IDE)
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, architecture) and communication/teaching skills
concerns: No Kotlin experience mentioned anywhere in resume
No Spring, Quarkus, or Hibernate ecosystem experience
Java experience is minimal, dated, and not JVM-tooling focused
